Game Overview

At its heart, Adventure of Zenny is a platformer game about join Princess Zenny on a thrilling quest to save her father from a wicked curse. Dodge traps, collect crystal coins, and outsmart the rock monster in a perilous world of vibrant platforming challenges. With easy controls and captivating adventures, embark on an epic journey of bravery and discovery.
